body:
I'll look into this today. The thing is, this component worked perfectly
with no problems in 2.2.5 just never updated the search state. Every part
of my app works minus this now. I was in a rush when I made this issue
because I need it working next week. My bad on not giving you enough info!
I'll post here later today.
On Thu, Feb 9, 2017 at 04:27 Marie-Laure Thuret <notifications@github.com>
wrote:

> Hi @zackify <https://github.com/zackify>, this shouldn't happen normally
> as we perform a deepEqual when a component receive new props. So if the
> props didn't changed, the onSearchStateChange shouldn't be trigger
> infinitely.
>
> But sometimes depending on the upper component of the <InstantSearch/>
> root component, those infinite loops can still happen, for example in the react-router
> v3 recipe I had to implement the shouldComponentUpdate lifecycle method.
>
> Any chance you can provide a small sample to help us understand what's
> happening with your use case? Maybe you can use this jsfiddle template
> https://jsfiddle.net/h3nus3gg/?
>
> —
